evals.prompt: Convert the sample DITA guide Word document (sample-dita-guide.docx) to a complete DITA XML documentation set. Analyze the document structure, classify each major section into appropriate DITA topic types (concept, task, or reference), and generate well-formed XML files. Create a ditamap that links all topics hierarchically. Organize all outputs in the correct folder structure with topics in a /topics folder. Provide a conversion report summarizing the changes and decisions made.
evals.expected_output: A complete DITA project directory with: (1) Multiple .dita XML files properly typed as concept, task, or reference topics; (2) A project.ditamap file with hierarchical structure; (3) All files in correct folder structure (topics/, images/); (4) conversion-report.md documenting the conversion process; (5) All XML files that validate against DITA 1.3 DTD
